name: The "Ligue os Pontos" Program: Sustainable, Circular and Resilient Urban Agriculture in São Paulo

Please help uscomplete it.Problems and Purpose By fostering the development of a circular economy between rural producers and city-center consumers, the Ligue os Pontos program aims to:Support sustainable urban agriculture production for a healthier food system in São Paulo, in order to Limit the city’s unplanned and massive urban sprawl, and Guarantee food and water security[1]Background History and Context Organizing, Supporting, and Funding Entities Participant Recruitment and Selection Methods and Tools Used What Went On: Process, Interaction, and Participation Influence, Outcomes, and Effects Analysis and Lessons Learned See Also References [1] Lucas Antonio Cividanes Gomes and Clément da Cruz, "Towards a Sustainable, Circular and Resilient Urban Agriculture in São Paulo?: The "Ligue os Pontos" Program," Urbanistes du Monde 2019 Forum,https://www.academia.edu/40374560/Towards_a_Sustainable_Circular_and_Resilient_Urban_Agriculture_in_S%C3%A3o_Paulo_The_Ligue_os_Pontos_ProgramExternal Links Notes
